decision: Load Mexico through a read-only file adapter (lib/mexicoData.js, /api/mexico/*), as Peru does; outputs keep Colombia's table shape in data/mexico/geodb/csv
note: Colombia MySQL tables have no country column and INEGI state codes collide with DIVIPOLA department codes. A shared database with country_code is deferred to a separate project covering Colombia, Peru and Mexico.

decision: Municipal reference point = coordinates of the cabecera locality (CVE_CAB) from the Catálogo Único; the 16 Ciudad de México alcaldías, which have no cabecera code, use their locality 0001
note: Locality 0001 is each alcaldía's main locality (Milpa Alta: Villa Milpa Alta, its seat). No centroids are computed.

decision: Layer D IT establishments = SCIAN 2018 541510 + 518210 + 519290 (template ISIC 6201/6202/6209, 6311, 6312); each code also published separately
note: DENUE 05/2026 uses SCIAN 2018, not SCIAN 2023 as the source register assumed. 541510 covers software, IT consulting and other IT services together, so D1 'of them software' is not available. No software-publishing (5112) records exist in the file.

decision: Layer N1 businesses = private universe: DENUE minus associations (SCIAN 813), cooperatives by legal name and public-sector establishments (SCIAN 93 and classes named 'sector público'); the bulletin total is kept as its own column
note: User rule: be as close as possible to the countries already added, never less comparable. Colombia N1 comes from RUES, a private merchant register without non-profits or cooperatives. The one record repeated across sector files 72_1 and 72_2 (id 9701347) is kept so the total equals the published 6,138,075.

decision: Layer J cities: Ciudad de México by its 16 alcaldías (zone ids CMX-<cve_mun>) and Monterrey by the 16 municipalities of the Zona Metropolitana de Monterrey (MTY-<cve_mun>)
note: User chose Monterrey (over Guadalajara) and the metropolitan-municipality definition. Members from SEDATU, CONAPO and INEGI, Metrópolis de México 2020, cuadros A.19.1.01 and B.19.1.01 (5,322,117 inhabitants in 2020). Monterrey has no official internal division comparable to Colombian comunas; AGEBs would be far finer than Colombia's zones.

decision: Layer J counts use the N1 private universe. Size: micro = DENUE bands 0-10 people, medium_large = 51+ (INEGI strata). Template annex 3 groups mapped to SCIAN 2018 private classes: design 5414xx; accounting 541211, 541219; consulting 541610; research 541711, 541721, 541910; higher education and training 611211, 611311, 611411, 611421, 611431, 611511, 611631, 611691, 611698; private schools 611111-611171 (odd-ending private classes)
note: Same column names as Colombia fact_companies_zone. Colombia sizes by assets, so micro and medium/large shares are comparable only in direction. Arts and sports schools (611611, 611621; Colombian 8552-8553) and special-needs schools (611181) are left out, as the template codes do.

decision: Occupation mapping for ENOE 2025: SINCO 2019 -> SINCO 2011 (annex 'Tabla de equivalencia SINCO 2011 - 2019' of the SINCO 2019 manual) -> CIUO-08 (INEGI 'SINCO 2011. Tablas comparativas', sheet SINCO-CIUO) -> the 13 personas defined in data/geodb-v2/csv/fact_persona_profile.csv. A code enters a persona only when every linked CIUO-08 code belongs to it (Peru rule); other cases go to review
note: ENOE codes occupation with SINCO 2019 since Q3 2021 and INEGI publishes no direct SINCO 2019 -> CIUO-08 table. Outputs: data/mexico/outputs/f_sinco2019_ciuo08_correspondence_mx.csv, f_occupation_mapping_mx.csv, f_persona_correspondence_mx.csv, f_mapping_review_mx.csv (scripts/build-mexico-f-sinco-mapping.py).

decision: Include by review: 2321 in P13, 1329 in P04, 1319 and 1711 in P12, 2111 in P06
note: Titles fall inside the persona although the official tables also link minor non-persona CIUO-08 codes (or, for the new 2019 groups 1319 and 1329, no 2011 code). Without 2321, P13 would have no code; without 2111, P06 would rest only on hotel and tourism professionals. Listed in data/mexico/f_mapping_overrides.csv.

These codes link mostly to non-persona CIUO-08 occupations (historians, urban planners, physical-science technicians, geologists, judges, recreation and services managers, teachers n.e.c.). Listed in data/mexico/f_mapping_overrides.csv.

decision: ENOE 2025 definitions: tech sector = SCIAN 51; workplace size from P3Q (Q1) or P3L (Q2-Q4) for employees and from P3D and P3G for employers and own-account workers; top size band 251+; micro-businesses = own-account workers and employers in units of up to 10 people; works from home not available
note: ENOE codes activity with SCIAN hogares, where IT services (5415) sit inside 5411 with other professional services, so ISIC section J cannot be reproduced: outside-tech shares are overstated and layer_g_mx.json gives a sensitivity counting 5411. ENOE size bands split at 250 and give 1, 2-5, 6-10, so Colombia's 201+ and the template's micro limit of 9 cannot be applied. Place of work (P4F) is asked only of businesses without premises, so F10 stays empty, as in Peru.

decision: Layers C, K and L use SEP Formato 911 cycle 2024-2025, and layer E uses CONAPO population 2024
note: The files supplied are cycle 2024-2025 (2025-2026 not used). The Mexico source register's fallback rule applies: C, K and L move to 2024-2025 together and E uses population 2024. Totals check against SEP Principales Cifras 2024-2025.

decision: Layer K school = CCT work-centre code (secundaria clave_cct; media superior escuela minus its shift digit); campuses (media superior plantel) reported as an extra count; reach cap of 100 per CCT
note: User decision. Closest to Colombia, which counts schools by official school code (11,111) and reports campuses separately (13,894). CCT 58,471 vs campus 57,570; the basic-education file has no campus id.

decision: Layer I: monthly minimum wage = daily minimum wage × 30.4 days (2025: 278.80 × 30.4 = MXN 8,475.52; northern border 419.88 × 30.4); plans priced at the 2025 average FIX rate
note: User decision. Mexico sets the minimum wage per day; 30.4 (365/12) is the convention used when quoting it monthly. The FIX average uses the 251 daily determinations of 2025, matching ENOE 2025 incomes.

decision: C1 and L3 (ICT students) and fact_higher_ed_municipality.students_ict_field come from the ANUIES yearbook 2024-2025 (programme level): ICT = broad field 'Tecnologías de la Información y la Comunicación' (ISCED-F 06 equivalent), all levels and modalities; systems/computing programmes in other broad fields (3,175 students) reported separately
note: User decision. Deviation from the source register (ANUIES as cross-check only): the ANUIES file is the programme-level view of SEP 911 2024-2025, and its national, on-campus and municipal totals equal the 911 files exactly (checked at build time). Name joins: three short state names and two municipality aliases (Miahuatlán de Porfirio Díaz 20059; San Pedro Mixtepec 20318, placed by the 911 files).
